karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi anafu ei choes yn chwarae rygbi.
karty.priklad_cs: She injured her leg playing rugby (coes → [ch]oes after ei = her, aspirate).
karty.mnemo: AN AFFray (AN-AF-u) outside the pub – somebody got injured.

karty.priklad: Ydy gwyliau sgio yn apelio atoch chi?
karty.priklad_cs: Do skiing holidays appeal to you?

extra.pozn: apelio at (ata i, atat ti, ato fe, ati hi, aton ni, atoch chi, atyn nhw)

karty.priklad: Mae e'n chwysu'n ofnadwy pan mae e'n chwarae rygbi.
karty.priklad_cs: He sweats terribly when he plays rugby.
karty.mnemo: CHOOSE you (CHWYS-u) a towel – you're sweating buckets!

sever.priklad: Mae o'n chwysu'n ofnadwy pan mae o'n chwarae rygbi.
sever.priklad_cs: He sweats terribly when he plays rugby.

karty.priklad: Oedd rhaid i chi wthio'r car?
karty.priklad_cs: Did you have to push the car? (gwthio → [w]thio after i)
karty.mnemo: GWTH! – the sound of a hard shove: push the car out of the snowdrift.

karty.cs_upresneni: in the ground, with a spade
karty.priklad: Pala i lwybr i chi o flaen y car.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll dig you a path in front of the car (llwybr → [l]wybr as the object after the verb form).
karty.mnemo: PAL (PAL-u), grab a spade and help me dig!

karty.priklad: Am sawl elusen mae Mrs Morris yn sôn?
karty.priklad_cs: How many charities does Mrs Morris mention?

extra.pozn: sôn am (about something); am causes soft mutation: sôn am Gaerdydd

karty.mnemo: 'DOG, GEL!' (DI-OG-el): the dog is safe and snug in its kennel.

karty.priklad_cs: She's a real Welsh woman (Cymraes → [G]ymraes after yn).
karty.mnemo: iawn = right; go iawn = 'quite right' – the real thing.

extra.pozn: it follows the noun and doesn't change; go on its own = quite, fairly (go dda)

karty.priklad_cs: The ring is very valuable (modrwy → [f]odrwy after y, gwerthfawr → [w]erthfawr after yn).
I'll be there, definitely (pendant → [b]endant after yn; yn bendant = definitely).
karty.mnemo: A PENDANT (PENDANT) is a definite yes – no going back once you've given it.

karty.priklad: Os byddi di bant dros nos, bwyda i'r gath i ti.
karty.priklad_cs: If you're away overnight, I'll feed the cat for you (cath → [g]ath after y).
karty.mnemo: The BAND (BANT) is away on tour.

sever.priklad: Os byddi di i ffwrdd dros nos, bwyda i'r gath i ti.
sever.priklad_cs: If you're away overnight, I'll feed the cat for you (cath → [g]ath after y).
sever.pozn: north: i ffwrdd instead of bant (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi gwneud cwrs cymorth cyntaf.
karty.priklad_cs: I've done a first aid course.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; masculine (like cymorth)

karty.priklad: Mae rheolau iechyd a diogelwch yn bwysig yn y gweithle.
karty.priklad_cs: Health and safety rules are important in the workplace (pwysig → [b]wysig after yn).
karty.mnemo: iechyd = health (Iechyd da! = Cheers!), diogelwch = safety.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; both words are masculine

karty.priklad: Rhoia i'r gorau i fwyta siocled yfory!
karty.priklad_cs: I'll give up eating chocolate tomorrow! (bwyta → [f]wyta after i)
karty.mnemo: Literally 'to give the best (gorau) to' – hand over the best and stop.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; the final i causes the mutation

karty.priklad: Mae'r elusen yn achos da iawn wir.
karty.priklad_cs: The charity is a very good cause indeed.
